name: Ainda não olhes
description: Ainda não olhes is an opening for a group exhibition featuring artists from Ukraine and Portugal, curated by Ksenia Fokina.
longDescription:
Ainda não olhes marks the opening of a collective exhibition featuring artists from Ukraine and Portugal, curated by Ksenia Fokina. The works explore themes around personal vulnerability, hesitation, and what people choose to hide or withhold.

The event takes place at Espaço AL859 on Rua da Alegria on 13 November 2026, running from 19:00 to 22:00. Admission is free.
